g.text: 1. Outline of the assembled marker. Datum: the base plane z = 0 = underside of the base plate; the three ball feet protrude
0.1 mm below it and the rim of the tub wall stays 0.25 mm above it (rim relief). Visor (flat) face at y = 18.4.
2. Envelope Ø46.0 x 7.6 mm. Rev C stack: base plate 0.87 + adhesive sheet 0.13, PCB at z 1.0 to 1.8; optical axis
5.61 above the base plane. Camera baseline 20.0 (x = +-10.0).
3. Camera windows 5.0 x 3.4 x 0.5 mm, centred on x = +-10.0, in recesses 5.5 wide x 0.55 deep from z = 4.2
to the top face. Clear opening 4.0 wide, z = 4.6 to 6.8. Optical axis z = 5.61.
4. Sections A-A and B-B: drawing GL1-002. Parts: GL1-010 tub, GL1-011 base plate, GL1-020 cradle.
5. Nothing has been built. All purchased-part envelopes are provisional until checked against manufacturer drawings.
